entries.what: Grace arrives at 7:20 and tells Dana Whitfield in B12 she is handing off Science Olympiad because the van saga and her mother's care are eating her afternoons.
entries.outcome: Dana becomes sole Science Olympiad advisor; Grace keeps only Tuesday lunch lab-makeup sessions.

entries.what: Teaches periods 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 and uses a prep-period reusable worksheet for a week of lessons instead of building new activities.
entries.outcome: The worksheet covers the week and frees her afternoons.

entries.what: After school she picks up Nanay's prescriptions on Vinca and drives home, then watches the teleserye with Corazón at 9.
Grace runs the Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session in B12 for students who missed labs.
Teaches her five sections, including Dulce's third period, and grades quiz sets during prep.
At home Isabel and Grace argue briefly over phone use and dishes before dinner, with Corazón's sinigang leftovers on the table.
Grace teaches all day and eats leftover rice and ulam in B12 during prep.
entries.outcome: Normal day with no Olympiad meeting for the first time.

entries.what: Afterward she leaves on time to take Corazón to the drugstore and does the evening logistics alone since Ramón is on shift.
Grace answers parent emails at the kitchen table and checks the fridge calendar for Ramón's next on-days.
Grace and Dana eat lunch together in B12, and Dana vents about her evaluations and her new Olympiad duties.
Teaches her afternoon sections, and staff talk about the St. Anselm nurses union vote happening today.
Evening Grace helps Corazón with her glucose check indirectly and tidies the kitchen.
Homecoming day at Flats High has spirit dress-up and shortened energy in class; Grace teaches through it.
Grace submits the Friday form at 3:30 using her spreadsheet template.
Isabel goes to the homecoming game with Nadia while Grace stays home grading with Corazón.
entries.outcome: Isabel returns before the old 10 p.m. curfew.

entries.what: Saturday morning Grace shops at Ruiz Family Market and stops at Panadería Las Hermanas for rolls.
Isabel shows Grace a written plan for weekends with an 11 p.m. return and a 9 p.m. text with her location, and Grace agrees after reading it through.
entries.outcome: The curfew moves to 11 p.m. on weekends with a 9 p.m. location text.

entries.what: Evening Grace waters the calamansi and tomato pots and watches TV with Corazón.
Grace goes to Tagalog Mass at 9 with Corazón and signs up at Our Lady of the Marsh to pack boxes at the Nov 22 food drive.
Grace grades at the kitchen table after lunch.
In the evening she builds a holiday budget with the assistant and asks whether to skip Thanksgiving extras in case the furnace goes.
